blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The Segment Anything Model (SAM) relies heavily on massive manual annotations, creating a fundamental bottleneck for model scaling. While unsupervised methods attempt to learn object concepts from motion, they typically overfit to moving entities, lacking both multi-granularity understanding and the ability to generalize to static objects. To overcome this, we introduce Mo tion-Grounded S egment A nything ( MoSA ), a highly scalable unsupervised framework that learns a transferable objectness prior from unlabeled videos. MoSA operates in three progressive stages: (1) automatically generating multi-granularity motion pseudo-labels from large-scale video data; (2) training a P erceptual G rouping M odel ( PGM ) via contrastive learning to internalize a generalized, appearance-driven concept of objects; and (3) transferring this learned prior into a prompt-guided architecture for segment-anything-style inference on images. Extensive zero-shot evaluations across seven challenging benchmarks (e.g., COCO and ADE20K) demonstrate that MoSA significantly outperforms existing unsupervised methods. Notably, despite using zero manual annotations, MoSA achieves segmentation performance comparable to the fully supervised SAM. Our findings reveal that harnessing large-scale unlabeled motion is a feasible and highly scalable alternative to annotation-driven segment-anything pipelines. Code is available at https://github.com/360CVGroup/MoSA .
blocks.zh: 片段任意模式(SAM)严重依赖大规模人工说明,为模型的缩放制造了一个根本的瓶颈. 虽然不受监督的方法试图从运动中学习物体概念,但它们通常过于适合移动实体,既缺乏多角度的理解,也缺乏对静态物体的概括能力. 为了克服这一点,我们引入了Mo Totion-Grounded S ectionment A Nything(MOSA),这是一个高度可扩展的无监督的框架,它从没有标签的视频中学习到一个可转移的对象。 MOSA在三个进步阶段运作:(1)从大型视频数据自动生成多角运动伪标签;(2)通过对比性学习培训一个P erceptual G rooping M odel(PGM),将一个通用的,外观驱动的物体概念内化;以及(3)将之前学到的这个转移到一个快速导引的架构中,用于对图像进行分区-任何类推论. 对7项具有挑战性的基准(如COCO和ADE20K)进行广泛的零镜头评价表明,安保部的绩效大大超过现有无人监督的方法。 值得注意的是,尽管使用了零手动说明,MOSA还是实现了与完全监督的SAM相当的分割性能. 我们的调查结果表明,利用大规模无标签运动是可行的和高度可扩展的,可以替代注解驱动的区段-任何管道。 代码见https://github.com/360CVGroup/MOSA 。 。 。

blocks.en: The Segment Anything Model (SAM) [ 15 ] has established a new standard for zero-shot generalization in computer vision. However, its success heavily relies on the massive, manually annotated SA-1B dataset. This dependence on costly supervision creates a fundamental bottleneck for further model scaling. Consequently, annotation-free unsupervised learning has emerged as a crucial direction for scalable, general-purpose segmentation.
blocks.zh: 分段任意模式(SAM)[15]为计算机视觉中的零射一般化确立了新的标准. 然而,它的成功很大程度上依赖于大量人工注释的SA-1B数据集. 这种对费用高昂的监督的依赖为进一步扩大模型制造了一个根本的瓶颈。 因此,无注解的无监督学习已成为可扩展的普通用途分化的关键方向。

blocks.en: Existing unsupervised segmentation methods generally fall into two categories: image-based and video-based approaches. Image-based methods, such as CutLER [ 36 ] and UnSAM [ 38 ] , leverage self-supervised representations (e.g., DINO [ 4 ] ) to perform feature clustering or pseudo-label generation, achieving competitive unsupervised segmentation performance. Nevertheless, these approaches infer objectness primarily from static appearance cues, such as texture, color, and shape, overlooking the cognitive priors humans develop through continuous observation of the dynamic world.
blocks.zh: 现有的不受监督的分割方法一般分为两类:基于图像的方法和基于视频的方法. 基于图像的方法,如CutLER[36]和UnSAM[38],利用自我监督的表示(如DINO[4])来进行特征集群或伪标签生成,实现竞争性的无监督分化性能. 尽管如此,这些方法主要从静态的外观提示,如纹理,颜色,和形状推断出物体性,俯瞰人类通过持续观测动态世界而形成的认知前身.

blocks.en: Research in developmental psychology, particularly Gestalt theory [ 17 , 16 ] , suggests that the human ability to group objects is largely driven by motion cues. Video-based methods naturally exploit these motion cues. Early approaches typically focus on detecting moving foreground regions, often producing binary masks without explicitly modeling multiple object instances or detailed structures [ 43 , 41 , 20 ] . Recent advances extend unsupervised video object segmentation (U-VOS) toward instance- and scene-level understanding. For example, OCLR [ 40 ] proposes an object-centric model trained on synthetic data to discover and track multiple moving objects. Other methods rely on videos during training but can perform inference on static images without requiring motion information. Methods such as RCF [ 22 ] and DyStaB [ 42 ] exploit motion-induced grouping to generate object masks, often combining motion and appearance refinement within bootstrapping frameworks. Furthermore, approaches like DIOD [ 14 ] integrate motion-guided discovery with self-distillation to improve pseudo-label quality. Although these methods prove that motion is a powerful supervisory signal for object concepts, they face two major limitations. First, they easily overfit to moving objects, struggling to generalize to static or weakly moving entities (e.g., the roof tiles in Fig. 1 ). Second, they are largely confined to instance-level segmentation, lacking multi-granularity understanding. To truly emulate human perception, a scalable model must generalize from moving entities to anything in static scenes, expanding its object vocabulary from growing unlabeled videos.
blocks.zh: 对发育心理学的研究,特别是Gestalt理论[17,16],表明人类将物体分组的能力主要是由运动提示驱动的. 基于视频的方法自然利用这些运动提示. 早期的方法一般侧重于探测移动的展望区域,往往产生二进制口罩,而没有明确建模多个物体实例或详细结构[43,41,20]. 最近的进展将未经监督的视频物体分区(U-VOS)延伸到实例和场景层面的理解。 例如,OCLR[40]提出一个以合成数据为训练的以物体为中心的模型,以发现和跟踪多个移动物体. 其他方法在训练期间依赖于视频,但可以在不需要运动信息的情况下对静态图像进行推论. 区域合作框架[22]和DyStaB[42]等方法利用运动引起的分组来产生物体遮罩,常常将运动和外观的改进结合在拖曳框架内。 此外,DIOD[14]等方法将运动制导的发现与自我蒸发结合起来,以提高伪标签的质量。 虽然这些方法证明了运动是物体概念的强大监督信号,但它们面临两大限制. 首先,它们容易过度适合移动对象,难以被概括为静态或微弱移动的实体(如图1中的屋顶瓦片)。 其次,它们基本上局限于实例级分割,缺乏多角度的理解。 要真正模仿人类的认知,一个可扩展的模型必须从移动实体到静态场景中的任何事物,从不断增长的无标签视频中扩展其对象词汇.

blocks.en: Motivated by this insight, we introduce Mo tion-Grounded S egment A nything ( MoSA ), a three-stage unsupervised framework designed to learn a transferable, general-purpose segmentation capability from unlabeled videos (see Fig. 1 ). In the first stage, we develop a M ulti- G ranularity M otion S egmentation ( MGMS ) pipeline. Pre-trained on synthetic data and subsequently applied to real-world unlabeled videos, MGMS generates high-quality motion-based pseudo-labels at scale without manual annotation. In the second stage, we train a P erceptual G rouping M odel ( PGM ) using these motion pseudo-labels. This stage encourages the model to internalize a generalized, appearance-driven notion of objectness that no longer depends on motion cues. Finally, an efficient adaptation stage transfers the learned objectness prior to a prompt-guided, high-resolution segmentation architecture, enabling strong zero-shot segment-anything performance. We conduct extensive evaluations on seven challenging segmentation benchmarks, including COCO [ 23 ] and ADE20K [ 46 ] . Experimental results demonstrate that MoSA consistently outperforms existing unsupervised segmentation methods across all benchmarks. Notably, despite being trained entirely without manual annotations, MoSA achieves zero-shot segmentation performance comparable to SAM, which relies on large-scale supervised data. These findings suggest that learning general object perception from large-scale unlabeled motion is both feasible and scalable, offering a promising path toward foundational general-purpose segmentation. Our main contributions are as follows: • We propose MoSA , a motion-grounded segmentation framework that learns from unlabeled videos to acquire a general-purpose, multi-granularity segmentation capability without manual annotation. • We introduce a P erceptual G rouping M odel ( PGM ) with a contrastive learning objective that allows the model to generalize beyond motion-specific cues, facilitating the discovery and segmentation of unseen static objects. • MoSA achieves new state-of-the-art performance in unsupervised segmentation across extensive experiments, proving that learning general objectness from motion is a scalable and practical route to developing foundational vision models.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Unsupervised Image Segmentation
blocks.zh: 无监督的图像分割

blocks.en: Unsupervised image segmentation aims to automatically identify and segment objects from static images without manual annotations [ 13 , 34 ] . Methods such as LOST [ 31 ] and TokenCut [ 39 ] leverage patch-level features from pretrained vision transformers (e.g., DINO family [ 4 , 27 , 32 ] ) to localize salient objects via feature affinity and graph-based partitioning. CutLER [ 36 ] introduces a cut-and-learn pipeline that discovers pseudo-masks and trains segmentation models in a self-supervised manner, demonstrating strong multi-instance detection and segmentation capabilities. UnSAM [ 38 ] adopts a divide-and-conquer strategy that combines hierarchical grouping and mask refinement to generate multi-granularity pseudo-labels, enabling both automatic and promptable segmentation. A common thread in these image-based approaches is their reliance on DINO features and the subsequent use of hierarchical clustering to generate pseudo-labels. However, they may lack the robust, world-grounded prior knowledge that humans develop through extensive, long-term observation.
blocks.zh: 无监督的图像分割旨在自动识别和分割来自静态图像的物体,而无需手动说明[13,34]. 损失[31]和托肯等方法 剪切 [39] 杠杆补丁级特性从预先训练的视觉变压器(如DINO家族[4,27,32]),通过特征亲和和以图表为基础的分割来定位显著物体. CutLER [36] 引入了一条切换式输油管,以自我监督的方式发现了伪面板和列车分区模型,显示出强大的多层探测和分区能力. UnSAM [38] 采用了分而兼之的策略,将分级分组和遮掩完善结合起来,生成多角性伪标签,既能自动分解,又能迅速分解. 这些基于图像的方法中一个共同的线程是它们依赖DINO特性,以及随后使用等级集群生成伪标签. 然而,它们可能缺乏人类通过广泛、长期观察而发展起来的强大、以世界为基础的事先知识。

blocks.en: Motion-to-Objectness Bootstrapping
blocks.zh: 动作对对象

blocks.en: A growing body of research leverages motion as a natural supervisory signal for self-supervised object discovery. The standard paradigm extracts motion segments from videos to train static image models, allowing the concept of “objects” to generalize beyond initially moving regions. For instance, DyStaB [ 42 ] partitions the motion field by minimizing the mutual information between segments, then employs a dynamic-static bootstrapping strategy that iteratively alternates between motion-based segmentation and static model learning. RCF [ 22 ] combines relaxed common-fate grouping with appearance refinement to generate object masks. Furthermore, Bao et al . [ 2 ] utilize a slot-attention framework to discover independently moving objects, while DIOD [ 14 ] integrates motion guidance with self-distillation to enhance pseudo-label quality. However, existing methods remain confined to narrow, specialized scenarios. Their training objectives focus heavily on extracting precise instance masks rather than learning a universal, transferable “object prior” necessary for foundational “segment-anything” capabilities. Furthermore, they are strictly restricted to instance-level predictions and cannot comprehend objects across multiple granularities (e.g., distinguishing a part from a whole). Consequently, their learned representations suffer from a severe motion bias —they overfit to motion-salient regions and fail on static or rarely moving objects. Ultimately, building a scalable, general-purpose segmentation model solely from motion cues remains an open challenge.
blocks.zh: 越来越多的研究利用运动作为自我监督物体发现的自然监督信号. 标准范式从视频中提取运动片段来训练静态图像模型,使得"对象"的概念能够概括到初始移动区域以外. 例如,DyStaB[42]通过最小化各段之间的相互信息来分割运动场,然后采用动态-静态的拖曳策略,在运动分区和静态模型学习之间迭代替代。 区域合作框架[22]将宽松的共缘组合与外观的完善结合起来,生成物体口罩. 此外,Bao et al.[2]利用时间档注意框架发现独立移动的物体,而DIOD[14]将运动导与自沉结合,以提高伪标签质量。 然而,现有方法仍然局限于狭隘的、专门的情景。 其培训目标主要侧重于提取精确的实例口罩,而不是学习一种普遍、可转移的“先验对象”,这是基本“任何部分”能力所必需的。 此外,它们严格限于实例级预测,无法理解多个颗粒体的物体(例如,将一部分与整个部分区分开来)。 因此,他们所学得的表述受到严重运动偏差的影响——他们过于适合运动偏差区域,在静态物体或很少移动物体上失效。 归根结底,仅从运动提示建立可伸缩的、通用的分区模式仍然是一个公开的挑战。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : An overview of our Multi-Granularity Motion Segmentation (MGMS) pipeline for generating high-quality pseudo-labels from unlabeled videos. The pipeline first extracts bidirectional optical flow from videos and processes it through two parallel modules: the Rigid Object Segmentation Module and the Motion Foreground Segmentation Module. These generate masks for rigid parts and the moving foreground of the central frame (highlighted in red). Finally, masks are filtered and processed with NMS to yield the final multi-granularity pseudo-labels.

blocks.en: 3 Motion Pseudo-Label Generation
blocks.zh: 3 动画 Pseudo-Label 世代

blocks.en: To learn object concepts from motion without manual supervision, MoSA begins with a M ulti- G ranularity M otion S egmentation ( MGMS ) pipeline that generates high-quality pseudo-labels from unlabeled videos. Within the MGMS pipeline, motion segmentation modules are first trained on synthetic video data. These modules are subsequently applied to large-scale real-world videos to produce a large set of candidate masks (see Fig. 2 ). Finally, a dedicated quality assessment metric is introduced to filter the generated candidates, resulting in a high-quality, multi-granularity motion pseudo-label dataset for subsequent-stage training.
blocks.zh: 为了从运动中学习对象概念而无需人工监督,MOSA开始使用Multi-G ranulaity M otion S egmentation(MGMS)管道,从没有标签的视频中生成高质量的伪标签. 在MGMS管道内,运动分区模块首先接受合成视频数据培训. 这些模块随后被应用到大型现实世界视频中,以制作一大批候选口罩(见图2 ). 最后,引入了一个专门的质量评估指标,以过滤生成的候选人,从而形成高质量、多角运动伪标签数据集,供以后阶段培训使用。

blocks.en: 3.1 Synthetic Video Generation
blocks.zh: 3.1 合成视频生成

blocks.en: Segmenting moving objects from real-world videos is inherently challenging due to confounding factors such as complex camera motion, occlusions, and diverse object dynamics (e.g., rigid versus non-rigid motion). To mitigate these challenges and provide clean supervisory signals, we introduce a video synthesis pipeline to train our motion segmentation modules. Inspired by [ 19 ] , we generate synthetic videos with accurately constructed ground-truth masks. We extend the original framework to support multiple objects and complex occlusions. Specifically, for each synthetic video, a background image is sampled as the background texture, and random affine transformations are applied to simulate camera motion. We then generate multiple foreground objects, represented as randomly shaped and textured patches. Each object moves independently along a smooth B-spline trajectory and undergoes random perspective transformations, with inter-frame smoothness constraints to mimic natural motion and deformation. Although synthetic videos lack semantic realism, they provide unambiguous motion cues and pixel-accurate masks, making them well-suited for training general-purpose motion segmentation models.
blocks.zh: 从现实世界的视频中分离移动的物体在本质上具有挑战性,因为复杂的相机运动,隐蔽,以及多样的物体动力学(如刚性运动与非刚性运动)等混淆因素. 为了减轻这些挑战和提供干净的监督信号,我们采用了一个视频合成管道来培训我们的运动分区模块。 在[19]的启发下,我们用精确构造的地面真人面具生成合成视频. 我们扩展原始框架,以支持多个对象和复杂的隔离。 具体来说,对于每个合成视频,一个背景图像作为背景纹理进行取样,随机的芳香变换应用来模拟相机运动. 然后我们产生多个前景物体,以随机形状和纹理的补丁表示。 每个物体都沿着一个平滑的B-spline轨迹独立移动,并经历随机的视角转变,具有机体间平滑性的限制来模仿自然运动和变形. 虽然合成视频缺乏语义现实主义,但它们提供了毫不含糊的运动提示和像素精确的口罩,使其非常适合训练通用运动分裂模型.

blocks.en: 3.2 Multi-Granularity Motion Segmentation
blocks.zh: 3.2 多角运动分裂

blocks.en: To capture motion at varying levels of detail, we design a pipeline with two complementary modules, both trained on our synthetic data. The first module focuses on instance-level segmentation of rigidly moving objects, while the second identifies the entire moving foreground. This multi-granularity strategy ensures a comprehensive capture of diverse motion patterns. Further training details for each module are provided in Appendix 0.C.1 .
blocks.zh: 为了捕捉不同程度的运动,我们设计了一个带有两个互补模块的管道,两个模块都接受了关于我们合成数据的培训。 第一个模块侧重于刚性移动对象的实例级分割,而第二个模块则识别整个移动前缘. 这种多角性战略确保全面捕捉不同的运动模式. 每个单元的进一步培训详情见附录0.C.1。

blocks.en: Rigid Object Segmentation Module (ROSM)
blocks.zh: 固定对象分割模块(ROSM)

blocks.en: This module is designed to segment individual objects that undergo coherent motion. In our context, “rigid motion” refers to any motion pattern that can be well-approximated by a single perspective transformation. This assumption holds not only for truly rigid objects (e.g., a car), but also for instance parts (e.g., a person’s arm) or even static elements exhibiting parallax due to camera motion. Our synthetic data, where each object follows a distinct transformation, provides an ideal training ground for this task. We formulate this as an instance segmentation problem, adapting the SOLOv2 framework [ 35 ] to operate on bidirectional optical flow. For a given flow field, the module outputs a set of instance masks, each corresponding to a distinct moving entity, along with a confidence score.
blocks.zh: 这个模块旨在分割个别物体,使其发生连贯的运动。 在我们的背景中,“刚性运动”是指任何能够完全通过单一视角转变来接近的运动模式。 这种假设不仅适用于真正僵硬的物体(例如汽车),而且适用于零件(例如人的手臂),甚至由于照相机运动而显示抛物的静态元素。 我们的合成数据,即每个物体都经过不同的转变,为这项任务提供了理想的训练基础。 我们将此作为一个实例分解问题,调整SOLOv2框架[35],在双向光学流上运行。 对于一个特定的流场,模块输出一组实例口罩,每个口罩对应一个不同的移动实体,同时输出一个信心分数.

blocks.en: Motion Foreground Segmentation Module (MFSM)
blocks.zh: 运动前景分区模块(MFSM)

blocks.en: While the rigid object module excels at segmenting coherent motion, it struggles with complex, non-rigid deformations, such as a walking person whose limbs move semi-independently. To address this, we introduce a module that performs a simpler, yet highly effective task: separating the entire moving foreground from the background. This yields high-quality masks for complex non-rigid objects, complementing the instance-level output of the first module. To this end, we employ a U-Net architecture [ 30 ] that takes bidirectional optical flow as input and outputs a single binary mask delineating all moving regions within the central frame.
blocks.zh: 虽然刚性物体模块在分化连贯运动方面表现优异,但它却与复杂,非刚性变形相搏,如一个行走者,其四肢半独立运动. 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了一个模块,履行一个简单但非常有效的任务:将整个移动前景与背景分开。 这为复杂的非刚性物体提供了高质量的口罩,补充了第一个模块的例级输出. 为此,我们采用了U-Net架构[30],采用双向光学流作为输入,并输出一个单一的二进制遮罩,在中央构架内划分所有移动区域.

blocks.en: 3.4 Pseudo-Label Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 3.4 Pseudo-Label 数据集建设

blocks.en: We applied our MGMS pipeline to a diverse collection of large-scale public video datasets 1 1 1 We emphasize that no manual annotations (e.g., labels, boxes, masks) from these datasets were used, and we ensured no overlap with our downstream evaluation benchmarks. . The videos span a wide range of scenes, including human activities, animal behaviors, and driving footage. The complementary nature of our two segmentation modules allows us to generate a rich, multi-granularity dataset. The rigid instance module identifies distinct objects and parts, while the motion foreground module captures complete non-rigid entities. From approximately 10,000 hours of raw video, we generated around 21 million high-quality motion pseudo-labels. This large-scale, automatically curated dataset forms the foundation for training our Perceptual Grouping Model, as detailed in the next section.
blocks.zh: 我们用我们的MGMS管道来收集大规模公共视频数据集。 我们强调,没有使用这些数据集的手动说明(例如标签、盒子、口罩),我们确保不与我们的下游评估基准重叠。 视频横跨了广泛的场景,包括人类活动,动物行为,以及驾驶镜头. 我们的两个分区模块具有互补性,使我们能够生成一个丰富、多角度的数据集。 刚性实例模块识别出不同的对象和部件,而运动前地模块捕捉到完整的非刚性实体. 从大约10000小时的原始视频中,我们产生了大约2100万个高质量的运动伪标签. 这种大规模自动整理的数据集构成了培训我们概念分组模型的基础,详情见下一节。

blocks.en: 4 Learning from Motion to Segment Anything
blocks.zh: 4 从动议到分部的学习

blocks.en:
While the pseudo-labels from Section 3 are derived from motion, our ultimate goal is to train a universal segmentation model that operates on static images, without any reliance on motion cues at inference time. However, a fundamental challenge arises from the nature of our pseudo-supervision: the masks generated from motion are high-quality but inherently sparse, covering only a fraction of the objects present in an image, e.g., one of the tiger’s paws in Fig. 2 . To bridge this gap, we introduce the P erceptual G rouping M odel ( PGM ), a framework designed to learn a generalizable concept of “objectness” from this limited supervision.
Central to our approach is a novel contrastive training strategy, which enables the model to discover unlabeled objects beyond the provided masks.
blocks.zh:
虽然第3节的伪标签来自运动,我们的最终目标是训练一种通用的分片模式,在静态图像上运作,在推断时间不依赖运动提示. 然而,一个根本性的挑战来自我们伪监督的性质:运动产生的口罩质量很高,但内在是稀少的,只覆盖图像中存在的一小部分物体,例如图2中的虎爪之一。 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了Perceptual G rooping M odel(PGM)这一框架,目的是从这种有限的监督中学习一个概括的“目标”概念。
我们的方法的核心是新型的对比性训练策略,它使模型能够发现所提供面具以外的无标签物体。

blocks.en: 4.1 Perceptual Grouping Model Architecture
blocks.zh: 4.1 概念分组模式架构

blocks.en: PGM is built upon a standard Vision Transformer (ViT) [ 8 ] backbone. To capture objects at various scales, PGM incorporates K K parallel linear projection heads on top of the ViT features. During training, each pseudo-mask is assigned to a specific head based on its bounding box size. The loss for that mask is computed exclusively using the features from its assigned head. This strategy encourages different heads to specialize in segmenting objects of different scales. Furthermore, to enhance robustness against occlusions and complex scenes, we employ the Copy-Paste data augmentation technique [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh: PGM基于一个标准的ViT变形器[8]骨干. 为了捕捉不同尺度的物体,PGM在ViT特性的顶部结合了K K平行线性投影头. 在训练期间,每个假面具都根据其边框大小分配到特定的头部. 面具的损失完全用它指定的头部的特征计算。 这一策略鼓励不同的头专门将不同尺度的物体分开. 此外,为了增强防堵和复杂场景的强度,我们采用了复制件数据增强技术[9]。

blocks.en: 4.2 Perceptual Grouping Contrastive Learning (PGCL)
blocks.zh: 4.2 观念分组矛盾学习

blocks.en: Standard segmentation objectives, such as Binary Cross-Entropy (BCE) [ 30 ] or Dice loss [ 33 ] , are suboptimal for our training data. Since motion-based pseudo-labels are inherently sparse, these losses erroneously penalize unannotated object instances as background. While Slot Attention [ 14 ] addresses sparsity, it struggles in open-world settings: its fixed slot capacity clashes with the varying number of objects in open-world scenes, and its rigid pixel-to-slot assignment hampers multi-granularity segmentation. Crucially, slot-centric representations tend to overfit to the specific object categories seen during training, limiting zero-shot generalization to unseen domains.
blocks.zh: 标准分解目标,如二进制交叉式(BCE)[30]或二进制损失[33],对我们的培训数据来说是次优的. 由于基于运动的假标签本来就很少,这些损失错误地将无说明的物体作为背景加以惩罚。 虽然Slot Note [14] 处理的是sparsity,但它在开放世界的环境下挣扎:它的固定槽容量与开放世界场景中不同数量的物体发生冲突,它的刚性像素到slot分配会阻碍多角分化. 关键是,以档位为中心的表示方式往往与训练中看到的具体对象类别过于吻合,将零射一般化限制在看不见的领域。

blocks.en: 4.3 Adaptation to Segment Anything
blocks.zh: 4.3 适应任何部分

blocks.en: While PGM learns a general notion of objectness, it is trained on relatively low-resolution video frames and lacks prompt-based interaction capabilities. To bridge this gap and enable high-performance, high-resolution segmentation with prompt-based interaction, we leverage PGM to generate high-quality masks on high-resolution static images. We then utilize these perceptual grouping masks to train two specialized models for distinct segment anything tasks.
blocks.zh: PGM虽然学习了一般的物体概念,但接受了相对低分辨率视频帧的培训,缺乏即时互动能力. 为了弥合这一差距,并且能够以即时的相互作用实现高性能,高分辨率的分割,我们利用PGM在高分辨率的静态图像上生成高质量的口罩. 然后我们利用这些感知的组合口罩 来训练两个专门的模型 来完成任何任务

blocks.en: PGM Inference
blocks.zh: 首相 推论

blocks.en: Our perceptual grouping masks generation begins by feeding a static image into the pre-trained PGM. PGM processes the image to generate an initial pool of candidate soft masks, derived from patch embeddings through pairwise cosine similarity. These candidates are then filtered based on a predicted mask quality score (Sec. 3.3 ) and refined using a dense Conditional Random Field (CRF) [ 18 ] to sharpen object boundaries. For high-resolution imagery, we employ a multi-scale, sliding-window approach: PGM inference is applied independently to overlapping tiles at various resolutions. Masks from all tiles are subsequently projected back, merged, and filtered via Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS) to remove duplicates and produce the final comprehensive and fine-grained results. Further implementation details can be found in Appendix 0.C.2 .
blocks.zh: 我们的感官组装口罩的生成 首先是将静态图像输入到预训PGM中 PGM处理图像以生成一个初始的候选软面罩集合,从补丁嵌入通过对偶余弦相似性得到. 这些考生随后根据预测的面具质量分数(第3.3节)进行过滤,并使用密集的有条件随机场(CRF)[18]进行精炼,以磨合对象边界. 对于高分辨率图像,我们采用多尺度的滑窗方法:PGM推论在各种分辨率中独立应用于重叠的瓦片. 所有瓷砖的面具随后通过Non-Maximum Puture(NMS)向后投射,合并和过滤,以去除重复,产生最终的全面和精细的结果. 进一步的执行情况详见附录0.C.2。

blocks.en: Training the Segment Anything Models
blocks.zh: 培训任意模式

blocks.en: We apply the aforementioned inference pipeline to generate perceptual grouping masks on a 1% subset of the high-resolution SA-1B dataset [ 15 ] . We then train two Segment Anything models, following the approach of UnSAM [ 38 ] :
blocks.zh: 我们利用上述推论管道在高分辨率的SA-1B数据集的1%子集上产生感知分组罩[15]. 然后,我们按照UNSAM[38]的方法,训练两个区段任意模式:

blocks.en:
• Whole-Image Segmentation: For universal object segmentation, we train a Mask2Former model [ 6 ] . This model accepts a full high-resolution image as input and automatically outputs a set of masks, where each mask corresponds to a distinct instance discovered in the scene. • Promptable Segmentation: To build a prompt-driven model, we adopt an architecture based on Semantic-SAM [ 21 ] , which excels at predicting masks at multiple granularity levels from a single click.
To enable interactivity, we simulate user clicks during training by randomly sampling a point within the foreground of each mask to serve as a positive point prompt.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Training Setups
blocks.zh: 5.1 培训机构

blocks.en: MGMS Pipeline Training Settings
blocks.zh: MGMS 管道培训设置

blocks.en: Our MGMS Pipeline comprises two key modules: ROSM employs a SOLO-v2 architecture [ 35 ] with a ResNet-18 backbone [ 12 ] , while MFSM utilizes a Res-UNet architecture [ 45 ] , also with a ResNet-18 backbone. Both modules take a sequence of 7 frames as input and were trained on a synthetic dataset for 50,000 iterations with an input resolution of 512 × 512 512\times 512 and a batch size of 32.
blocks.zh: 我们的MGMS 管道由两个关键模块组成:ROSM使用SOLO-v2架构[35],具有ResNet-18主干线[12];MFSM则使用Res-UNet架构[45],也具有ResNet-18主干线. 两个模块都采用7帧的序列作为输入,并接受了5万次迭代的合成数据集培训,输入分辨率为512×512 512\时,批量大小为32.

blocks.en: PGM Training Settings
blocks.zh: 首相 培训设置

blocks.en: The training data for PGM comprises 21 million pseudo-labels distributed across 10 million static frames. This dataset was generated from a 10,000-hour video corpus constructed from three major sources: Kinetics-700 [ 5 ] , which contains approximately 650,000 10-second clips covering a wide range of human actions; BDD100K [ 44 ] , a large-scale driving video dataset designed for diverse road scenarios; and a 5% random sample from YouTube-8M [ 1 ] , a broad-coverage video collection sourced from YouTube. PGM utilizes a ViT-base architecture [ 8 ] with an input size of 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixels. The architecture is topped by four parallel heads, each implemented as a linear layer that produces 128-dimensional feature vectors. We employ the AdamW [ 25 ] optimizer with a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} and a batch size of 32.
blocks.zh: PGM的培训数据包括分布在1 000万个静态框架的2 100万个假标签。 这个数据集来自从三个主要来源构建的1万小时视频集: Kinetics-700 [5],其中包含约65万个10秒的短片,涵盖广泛的人类行动;BDD100K [44],一个大型的驱动视频数据集,为各种道路情景设计;以及来自YouTube-8M [1]的5%随机样本,从YouTube获取的宽覆盖视频采集. PGM使用ViT基架构[8],输入大小为512×512 512\times 512像素. 该架构由四个平行头顶,每个头顶作为线性层执行,产生128维特性向量. 我们使用 AdamW [25] 优化器, 学习率为 1×10−4 1\times 10×4} 批量大小为 32 。

blocks.en: Segment Anything Model Training Settings
blocks.zh: 模块培训设置

blocks.en: For whole-image segmentation, we construct a model by integrating a Mask2former [ 6 ] decoder with a ResNet-50 [ 12 ] backbone. Training is conducted for 8 epochs, configured with a 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} learning rate, a batch size of 16, and 0.05 weight decay. For promptable segmentation, we leverage the Semantic-SAM [ 21 ] architecture with a Swin-Transformer [ 24 ] Tiny model as the backbone to improve performance. Both models are trained with only a 1% subset of unlabeled images from SA-1B [ 15 ] .
blocks.zh: 对于全图像分割,我们通过整合一个Mask2former[6]解码器与ResNet-50[12]骨干来构建一个模型. 培训对象为8个学期,配置为5×10−5 5×5乘10×5}学习率,批量大小为16,体重衰减0.05。 为了迅速分解,我们利用Semantic-SAM[21]架构,以Swin-Transformer[24]Tiny模型作为提高性能的骨干. 两个模型都只用来自SA-1B的1%的无标签图像子集来训练. [15].

blocks.en: 5.2 Evaluation Datasets and Metrics
blocks.zh: 5.2 评价数据集和计量

blocks.en: We evaluate MoSA under two segmentation settings: Whole-Image Segmentation and Point-Based Promptable Segmentation . For Whole-Image Segmentation, we evaluate MoSA on seven benchmark datasets, including COCO [ 23 ] , LVIS [ 10 ] , ADE20K [ 46 ] , EntitySeg [ 28 ] , SA-1B [ 15 ] , PartImageNet [ 11 ] , and PACO [ 29 ] . Importantly, each dataset only labels a subset of objects, whereas our model generates masks across heterogeneous levels and open-world categories. As a result, the standard COCO-style Average Precision (AP) metric may not fully capture the model’s ability to segment diverse, open-world entities. Therefore, following prior unsupervised segmentation works [ 36 , 38 , 3 ] , we adopt Average Recall (AR) as the primary metric for whole-image segmentation comparisons. For Point-Based Promptable Segmentation, we evaluate on COCO Val2017 [ 23 ] . Following prior promptable segmentation methods [ 15 , 21 ] , we report two metrics: MaxIoU and OracleIoU. MaxIoU measures the Intersection over Union (IoU) between the ground truth mask and the highest-confidence predicted mask, while OracleIoU reports the maximum IoU achieved among all predicted masks.
blocks.zh: 我们在两个分割设置下评估MOSA: 全图像分片和点状快速分片。 就全图像分解而言,我们以7个基准数据集对MOSA进行评价,包括CO[23]、LVIS[10]、ADE20K[46]、实体Seg[28]、SA-1B[15]、PartImageNet[11]和PACO[29]。 重要的是,每个数据集只标注一个子集的物体,而我们的模型则产生不同级别和开放世界类别的面具。 因此,标准COCO式平均精度(AP)度量可能无法完全抓住模型分解多样化的开放世界实体的能力。 因此,在以往未经监督的分割工程[36、38、3]之后,我们采用平均重回(AR)作为全图像分割比较的主要衡量标准。 对于点基快速分解,我们评价COCO Val 2017 [23]. 按照之前的快速分解方法[15,21],我们报告两个度量: MaxIoU和OracleIoU. MaxIoU测量在地面真假面具和最高自信预言面具之间的交叉(IoU),而OracleIoU则报告在所有预测面具中实现的最大IoU.

blocks.en: 5.3 Evaluation Results
blocks.zh: 5.3 评价结果

blocks.en: Perceptual Grouping Masks
blocks.zh: 概念组合面具

blocks.en: We quantitatively evaluate PGM on seven benchmarks. As shown in Table 1 , PGM generates high-quality masks. Notably, even without refinement, they significantly outperform the pseudo-labels used by UnSAM [ 38 ] , which are post-processed with CascadePSP [ 7 ] (a method relying on manual annotations). Qualitatively, Fig. 4 compares feature similarity maps of PGM and the strong self-supervised vision model DINOv3 [ 32 ] . The results highlight PGM’s superior ability to learn a holistic concept of “objectness”. For instance, in the top-right image, DINOv3 only activates on part of the snail, whereas PGM correctly segments the entire snail. Moreover, PGM shows remarkable zero-shot generalization. When applied to an out-of-distribution hand-drawn image (bottom-left), it successfully identifies the child figure , whereas the baseline fails to grasp this abstract concept. This suggests that our PGCL effectively teaches the model a generalizable notion of object coherence from sparse motion-based supervision.
blocks.zh: 我们从数量上评价七大基准的PGM。 如表1所示,PGM产生高质量的口罩. 值得注意的是,即使没有改进,它们也大大超越了UNSAM[38]所使用的伪标签,这些标签是在CascadePSP[7](一种依靠人工说明的方法)进行后处理的. Fig. 4在定性上比较了PGM的特征相似性图和强大的自我监督的视觉模型DINOv3 [32]. 调查结果突出表明,首相府具有学习 " 目标 " 整体概念的优越能力。 例如,在右上角图像中,DINOv3只在部分蜗牛上激活,而PGM则正确划分了整个蜗牛. 此外,PGM还表现出显著的零射一般化. 当应用到分布外的手绘图像(从下到左)时,它成功识别了儿童图,而基线则未能抓住这一抽象概念。 这表明,我们的PGCL有效地教给模型一个通用的物体一致性概念,从零星的基于运动的监督.

blocks.en: Whole-Image Segmentation

blocks.en: Table 2 presents the whole-image segmentation performance, measured by AR, of our unsupervised MoSA against baselines. Notably, MoSA, trained with only 1% of the SA-1B training data and utilizing a ResNet-50 backbone (only 23M parameters), achieves an average AR of 42.1%. This performance significantly outperforms previous unsupervised methods and the improvement is consistent across all seven datasets. Furthermore, on PartImageNet [ 11 ] and PACO [ 29 ] , MoSA surpasses the supervised SAM (ViT-B, 11M images) by 24.4% and 10.3% in AR, respectively. This suggests that pre-training on video motion cues enables the discovery of fine-grained objects and details often overlooked by human annotators. Qualitative results in Fig. 1 further illustrate this; notably, MoSA effectively segments even completely static objects, such as tiles on a roof. This capability is a direct consequence of PGCL, which extrapolates from sparse, motion-derived pseudo-labels to learn a universal concept of “objectness”. MoSA’s results align more closely with human perception of object instances and exhibit less segmentation noise.
blocks.zh: 表2按基线列出了我们未经监督的MOSA的全图像分解性能。 值得注意的是,只有1%的SA-1B培训数据得到培训并使用ResNet-50主干线(只有23M参数)的卫生部平均获得42.1%。 这一业绩大大超过以往未经监督的方法,所有七个数据集的改进是一致的。 此外,在PartImageNet[11]和PACO[29]上,卫生部在AR中分别超过监督的SAM(ViT-B,11M图像)24.4%和10.3%。 这表明,对视频动作提示的预训使得人们能够发现经常被人类注释者忽略的精细的物体和细节. 图1中的定性结果进一步说明了这一点;值得注意的是,MOSA甚至有效地分割了完全静止的物体,如屋顶上的瓷砖。 这种能力是PGCL的直接后果,它从稀少的、运动产生的伪标签推断出来,以学习“物体”的普遍概念。 卫生部的成果与人类对物体事件的认识更加一致,并表现出较少的分化噪音。

blocks.en: Point-Based Promptable Segmentation
blocks.zh: 基于点的快速分割

blocks.en: As shown in Table 3 , MoSA achieves 41.6% MaxIoU and 63.4% OracleIoU on COCO [ 23 ] . This notably outperforms the previous SOTA, UnSAM [ 38 ] , by +1.3% and +3.9% respectively. Crucially, UnSAM is not strictly unsupervised, as it relies on CascadePSP [ 7 ] , a refiner trained with manual annotations. While fully supervised SAM [ 15 ] sets a higher benchmark (52.1% MaxIoU, 68.2% OracleIoU), MoSA’s performance is compelling given its unsupervised nature and high efficiency, requiring 3.4 × \times fewer parameters and 100 × \times less SA-1B data. Qualitatively (Fig. 1 ), MoSA provides stable, perceptually-aligned, multi-granularity labels. For instance, even in challenging scenarios such as segmenting a person riding a horse (where their motion is often congruent), MoSA leverages video-learned semantics to accurately distinguish them. Additional qualitative results are in Appendix 0.E .

blocks.en: 5.4 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 5.4 阅读研究

blocks.en: PGM Training
blocks.zh: 首相 培训

blocks.en: To verify the effectiveness of our proposed PGCL, we conduct a comparative analysis against strong baselines using identical backbone architectures and training data (1,000 hours of video). Specifically, we compare PGCL with: (1) standard BCE+Dice loss, and (2) Slot Attention [ 14 ] with 256 slots. We evaluate the zero-shot transfer performance on 1,000 images from the SA-1B dataset, reporting Average Recall (AR) overall (AR 1000 {}_{\text{1000}} ) and across varying scales (AR s {}_{\text{s}} , AR m {}_{\text{m}} , AR l {}_{\text{l}} ). As presented in Table 4 , the conventional BCE+Dice baseline fails to segment most objects because sparse motion pseudo-labels wrongly suppress unlabeled static regions as background. Similarly, Slot Attention exhibits suboptimal performance (8.2 AR). We attribute this to the limitation of fixed slot capacity, which struggles to accommodate the uncertain number of objects and the multi-granular hierarchies inherent in open-world scenes. In contrast, our method achieves a substantial improvement, reaching 28.3 AR. This result confirms the superiority of PGCL in handling the complexity of the “segment anything” task.
blocks.zh: 为了核实我们提议的PGCL的有效性,我们利用相同的主干架构和培训数据(1,000小时视频),对照强基线进行了比较分析。 具体来说,我们比较PGCL与:(1)标准BCE+Dice损失,以及(2)分档注意[14]与256个插槽. 我们评价来自SA-1B数据集的1000张图像的零镜头传输性能,报告总体平均召回(AR 1000 QQText{1000}}),并跨不同尺度(AR s QQText{s}},AR m QQText{m}},AR l l QQText{l}}). 如表4所示,常规的BCE+Dice基线未能将大多数物体分割开来,因为零星运动伪标签错误地将无标签的静态区域压制为背景. 同样,Slot Record显示出业绩欠佳(8.2 AR)。 我们将此归因于对固定档位容量的限制,这种限制为适应不明物体数量和开放世界场景中固有的多格氏等级而挣扎. 相比之下,我们的方法取得了实质性的改进,达到了28.3 AR. 这一结果证实了PGCL在处理“任何部分”任务的复杂性方面的优越性。

blocks.en: MGMS Pipeline
blocks.zh: 导弹 管道

blocks.en: We ablate the MGMS Pipeline’s key components: the Rigid Object (ROSM) and Motion Foreground (MFSM) Segmentation Modules. Their efficacy is evaluated based on PGM’s Average Recall (AR) on 1,000 SA-1B images when trained on their generated pseudo-labels. As shown in Table 5 , ROSM alone excels on small objects (20.6% AR s {}_{\text{s}} ) but struggles with larger ones. Conversely, MFSM is effective for large objects (43.1% AR l {}_{\text{l}} ) but performs poorly on small ones (13.7% AR s {}_{\text{s}} ). The full pipeline integrates both modules to achieve the best overall score (36.6% AR 1000 {}_{\text{1000}} ). This confirms their complementary nature: combining ROSM’s precision for small objects with MFSM’s broader motion capture is essential for generating robust, multi-scale motion cues.

blocks.en: Number of Prediction Heads
blocks.zh: 预测头数

blocks.en: We ablate the number of prediction heads in PGM for multi-granularity segmentation. As shown in Fig. 5 (left), performance improves substantially from 27.9% AR with a single head to 36.6% AR with four heads. The most significant gain occurs when adding the second head (+4.2% AR), confirming the fundamental benefit of specialized heads. However, performance saturates beyond four heads, dropping marginally to 36.5% AR with five. This indicates that four heads provide the optimal trade-off, effectively capturing the full range of object scales from motion cues without introducing redundancy.
blocks.zh: 我们减少PGM中多角分化的预测头数。 如图5(左)所示,业绩大有改善,从27.9%的AR单头提高到36.6%的AR四头。 最显著的收益发生在第二头(+4.2%)的加成,确认专业头的基本利益. 然而,性能饱和度超过4个头,只有5个头稍降至36.5%。 这表明四个头提供了最佳的取舍,在不引入冗余的情况下,有效地从运动提示中捕捉到全部物体尺度.

blocks.en: Impact of Pre-training Video Data Scale
blocks.zh: 培训前的影响 视频 数据缩放

blocks.en: We investigate how the amount of unlabeled video data impacts PGM’s ability to learn motion priors. As illustrated on the right side of Fig. 5 , we observe a strong positive correlation between data scale and performance. Specifically, increasing the training data from 100h to 1,000h, and further to 10,000h, substantially boosts AR from 16.8% to 28.3% and finally to 36.6%. This clear, non-saturating trend underscores that our PGM effectively leverages large-scale video corpora and strongly suggests that its performance can be further enhanced by scaling to even larger datasets.
blocks.zh: 我们调查未贴标签的视频数据数量如何影响PGM学习运动前科的能力。 如图5右侧所示,我们发现数据尺度与性能之间有着很强的正相关关系。 具体而言,培训数据从100小时增加到1 000小时,再增加到10 000小时,使AR从16.8%提高到28.3%,最后提高到36.6%。 这种明确,不饱和的趋势突出表明,我们的PGM有效地利用了大型视频公司公司,并强烈建议通过规模化到更大的数据集来进一步提高其性能.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Perceptual grouping is fundamental to human visual intelligence, enabling us to transform raw visual data into semantic understanding through simple, yet powerful rules. Inspired by this biological process, we introduce MoSA, a novel three-stage unsupervised framework for learning generalized segmentation from motion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that by observing visual motion alone, MoSA learns robust segmentation abilities applicable to diverse objects and scenes. This approach not only outperforms existing unsupervised methods, but also offers a more interpretable and scalable path toward realizing “segment-anything.” Our work highlights the immense potential of learning object perception from motion as a fundamental building block for artificial visual intelligence, bridging the gap towards human-like perceptual understanding.
blocks.zh: 认知分组是人类视觉智能的基础,使我们能够通过简单而强大的规则将原始视觉数据转化为语义理解. 受这个生物过程的启发,我们引入了MOSA,一个小说三阶段的无监督框架,用于从运动中学习普遍分化. 广泛的实验表明,通过单独观察视觉运动,MOSA学习了适用于不同物体和场景的强分化能力. 这种做法不仅超越了现有的不受监督的方法,而且为实现“任何部分”提供了更可解释和可扩展的途径。 我们的工作突出了从运动中学习物体感知作为人工视觉智能的基本构件的巨大潜力,弥合了朝向人性感知理解的差距。

blocks.en: Appendix 0.A Synthetic Video Generation Details
blocks.zh: 附录0.A 合成视频生成细节

blocks.en: Each synthetic video is generated by first rendering a dynamic background and then superimposing multiple moving foreground objects. The key components of this process are detailed below. Notably, the entire synthesis process is unsupervised and does not rely on manually annotated data; all ground-truth masks are generated programmatically.
blocks.zh: 每个合成视频首先通过渲染动态背景生成,然后超强渲染多个移动前地物体. 这一进程的关键组成部分详述如下。 值得注意的是,整个综合过程不受监督,也不依赖人工附加说明的数据;所有地面真象面具都是按程序生成的。

blocks.en: 0.A.1 Background
blocks.zh: 0.A.1 背景情况

blocks.en: The dynamic background is designed to simulate various camera movements and global scene changes.
blocks.zh: 动态背景旨在模拟各种相机运动和全球场景变化.

blocks.en: Source
blocks.zh: 来源

blocks.en: For each synthetic video, we randomly select a single image from a data source that is distinct from all evaluation benchmarks to serve as the base background texture.
blocks.zh: 对于每一个合成视频,我们随机从一个数据源中选择一个不同于所有评价基准的单一图像作为基础背景纹理.

blocks.en: Motion Generation
blocks.zh: 运动生成

blocks.en: The static background image is animated by moving it along a smooth, randomly generated trajectory. This trajectory is defined by a sequence of 2D control points interpolated with B-splines. Concurrently, the background undergoes a random perspective transformation between frames. The parameters for these transformations are sampled randomly but are constrained to ensure smooth, temporally coherent changes, mimicking realistic camera motion.
blocks.zh: 静态背景图像通过沿平滑,随机生成的轨迹移动而成动画. 此轨迹由2D控制点与B-splines插合的序列来定义. 同时,背景在帧之间随机进行视角转换. 这些变换的参数是随机抽取的,但受限于确保平滑,时间连贯的变化,模仿现实的相机运动.

blocks.en: Motion Profile
blocks.zh: 运动配置

blocks.en: To introduce variability in relative motion speeds, we simulate two primary scenarios: • Fast Camera Motion : The background undergoes rapid transformations, such as large inter-frame displacements and perspective shifts. In this scenario, foreground objects are set to move more slowly. • Slow Camera Motion : The background exhibits slower, more subtle movements. Correspondingly, foreground objects exhibit faster and more pronounced motion.
blocks.zh: 为了引入相对运动速度的变异性,我们模拟两种主要情景: • 快相机运动: 背景发生了迅速的变化,如大范围的跨框架迁移和视角转变。 在这种情景下,前景对象被设定为更缓慢地移动. • 支助 慢镜头动作:背景显示动作较慢,更微妙. 与之相对应的是,前景物体显示速度更快,动作更明显.

blocks.en: Fast Camera Motion : The background undergoes rapid transformations, such as large inter-frame displacements and perspective shifts. In this scenario, foreground objects are set to move more slowly.
blocks.zh: 快速相机运动(Fast Camera Motion ):背景经历快速的转变,如大型的机身间移位和视角变化. 在这种情景下,前景对象被设定为更缓慢地移动.

blocks.en: Slow Camera Motion : The background exhibits slower, more subtle movements. Correspondingly, foreground objects exhibit faster and more pronounced motion.
blocks.zh: 慢镜头动作:背景显示动作较慢,更微妙. 与之相对应的是,前景物体显示速度更快,动作更明显.

blocks.en: 0.A.2 Foreground Objects
blocks.zh: 0.A.2 前景物体

blocks.en: Foreground objects are synthesized to introduce diverse shapes, appearances, and independent motion patterns, which are critical for learning motion-based segmentation.
blocks.zh: 前景物体被合成来引入不同的形状,外观,和独立的运动模式,这对于学习运动基分化至关重要.

blocks.en: Source
blocks.zh: 来源

blocks.en: Object shapes are randomly generated in accordance with the procedure in OCLR [ 40 ] , with textures sourced from a data collection kept separate from all evaluation benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 对象形状按照OCLR[40]中的程序随机生成,从数据收集中获取的纹理与所有评价基准保持分离.

blocks.en: Appearance Generation
blocks.zh: 外观生成

blocks.en:
The visual appearance of each foreground object is diversified through a two-step process.
First, the generated object mask undergoes random resizing and in-plane rotation, with angles sampled uniformly from [ 0,360 ∘ ) [0,360^{\circ}) .
Second, the transformed mask is treated as a sprite and re-textured. This involves randomly selecting an image, cropping a random patch from it, and applying this patch as the new texture for the sprite.
blocks.zh:
每个前方物体的视觉外观通过两步过程实现多样化.
首先,生成的物体掩体会进行随机的调整大小和飞机内旋转,角的采样统一从[0,360 ] [0,360^{\circ}].
第二,变形面具被作为宝石对待,并重新纹身. 这涉及到随机选择一个图像,从中裁剪一个随机的补丁,并将这个补丁作为新纹理应用到图示中.

blocks.en: Motion Generation
blocks.zh: 运动生成

blocks.en: To simulate dynamic scenes with varying complexity, the number of distinct moving foreground objects per video is randomly sampled from 1 to 15. Each object is initialized at a random 2D position in the first frame and follows an independently generated, smooth B-spline trajectory. Concurrent with its translation, each object also undergoes its own sequence of random perspective transformations across frames. These transformations are constrained to ensure inter-frame smoothness, simulating plausible object movement and deformation.
blocks.zh: 为了模拟具有不同复杂度的动态场景,每个视频中不同的移动前地对象的数量被随机抽样从1到15. 每个物体在第一帧的随机2D位置上初始化,并遵循独立生成的,平滑的B-spline轨迹. 与其翻译同时,每个对象也会经历自己的随机视角跨帧变换的顺序. 这些变形被限制在确保机身间平滑,模拟似似物体运动和变形.

blocks.en: Motion Disambiguation
blocks.zh: 动议混淆

blocks.en:
A critical aspect of our synthesis is ensuring that motion cues are sufficient to distinguish individual objects and separate them from the background, especially for optical flow-based models. To this end, we enforce two key constraints.
First, the motion trajectories (including translation, velocity, and perspective changes over time) of any two foreground objects within the same video are made unique by sampling different control points and parameters for their respective B-spline paths and transformations.
Second, the motion trajectory of each foreground object is also guaranteed to be distinct from the global background motion.
blocks.zh:
我们综合的一个关键方面是确保运动提示足以区分单个物体并将其与背景区分开来,特别是光学流基模型。 为此,我们实施了两个关键制约因素。
首先,同一视频中任何两个前方物体的运动轨迹(包括翻译,速度和视线随时间而变化)通过对各自B-spline路径和变换的不同控制点和参数进行取样而变得独特.
其次,每个前地物体的运动轨迹也保证与全球背景运动有所区别.

blocks.en: 0.A.3 Synthetic Data Visualizations
blocks.zh: 0.A.3 合成数据可视化

blocks.en: Fig. A1 provides visual examples from our synthetic dataset. These examples are specifically designed to be challenging, featuring heavy inter-object occlusions and complex motion trajectories that emulate difficulties found in real-world scenes. The visualizations include the input frames, the resulting optical flow, and the ground-truth segmentation masks, illustrating the direct link between the generated motion and the desired output. It is important to emphasize that the visual fidelity of textures and the precise shapes of the foreground objects are not the primary goal of our synthesis. Since our downstream model relies solely on optical flow as input, it is invariant to such high-level semantic cues. The key objective of our data generation is to produce diverse and complex motion patterns , which are effectively captured by the optical flow representation.
blocks.zh: 图A1提供了我们合成数据集的视觉实例。 这些例子专门设计为具有挑战性,以重的物体间隔离和复杂的运动轨迹为特征,模仿现实世界场景中发现的困难. 可视化包括输入帧,由此产生的光学流,以及地面-真实分解口罩,说明生成的运动与期望输出之间的直接联系. 必须强调的是,纹理的视觉忠贞性以及前方物体的精确形状并不是我们合成的首要目标. 由于我们的下游模型完全依赖于光学流作为输入,因此对于这种高层次的语义提示来说是不可更改的. 我们的数据生成的关键目标是产生多样化和复杂的运动模式,这些模式被光学流表达法有效捕获。

blocks.en: Appendix 0.B Motion Pseudo-Labels Generation Details
blocks.zh: 附录0.B 动画 Pseudo-Labels 生成细节

blocks.en: Serving as the critical data foundation of MoSA, the Multi-Granularity Motion Segmentation (MGMS) pipeline is designed to automatically generate high-quality motion pseudo-labels from large-scale unannotated videos. This section details how this framework processes unlabeled video data to extract robust motion cues. We first introduce the diverse video datasets that serve as input, followed by a comprehensive description of our preprocessing steps and the outputs derived from the specialized modules of the MGMS pipeline.
blocks.zh: 作为MOSA的关键数据基础,多角运动分块(MGMS)管道的设计旨在从大规模无附加说明的视频中自动生成高质量的运动伪标签. 本节详细介绍本框架如何处理无标签的视频数据以提取强势运动提示. 我们首先介绍作为输入的多种视频数据集,然后全面描述我们预处理步骤和MGMS管道专门模块产生的产出.

blocks.en: 0.B.1 Dataset Description
blocks.zh: 0.B.1 数据集说明

blocks.en: The training data for our model are derived from three large-scale public video datasets: • Kinetics-700 [ 5 ] : This dataset consists of approximately 650,000 video clips, encompassing 700 distinct human action classes. The videos feature a wide array of human-object interactions (e.g., playing instruments) and human-human interactions (e.g., shaking hands, hugging). Each action class is represented by at least 700 video clips, with each clip having an approximate duration of 10 seconds. • BDD100K [ 44 ] : A substantial driving video dataset containing 100,000 videos. It is designed for evaluating image recognition algorithms in the context of autonomous driving across 10 different tasks. The dataset is characterized by its diversity in geographic locations, environmental conditions, and weather patterns. • YouTube-8M [ 1 ] : A very large-scale video dataset comprising over 7 million videos, annotated with 4,716 classes by an automated system. Videos are categorized into 24 broad topics based on their visual content, including sports, gaming, arts & entertainment, among others. For our experiments, we utilized a random sample of 5% of the videos from this dataset.

blocks.en: It is important to reiterate that we did not utilize any human-provided annotations (such as labels, object bounding boxes, or segmentation masks) from these datasets. Our methodology relies solely on the visual content of the videos. Collectively, these datasets provide a rich and diverse collection of scenarios, encompassing human motion, object interactions, animal behavior, autonomous driving footage, and first-person perspectives. This diversity is crucial for training robust models capable of understanding complex dynamic scenes.
blocks.zh: 有必要重申的是,我们没有使用这些数据集中的任何人为说明(例如标签、物品捆绑盒或分区口罩)。 我们的方法完全依赖于视频的视觉内容。 这些数据集共同提供了丰富多样的情景集,包含人类运动,物体相互作用,动物行为,自主驾驶镜头,以及第一人称视角. 这种多样性对于培训能够理解复杂动态场景的强健模式至关重要。

blocks.en: 0.B.2 Data Preprocessing
blocks.zh: 0.B.2 信息技术 数据处理

blocks.en:
Our data processing pipeline begins with an initial filtering step to ensure that we only process videos with significant motion. To achieve this, the raw videos from the aforementioned datasets were processed by sampling clips at fixed 5-second intervals.
We compute optical flow for sampled video clips using GMFlow. We then calculate the mean magnitude of the optical flow vectors across all pixels and frames. Clips where this mean magnitude falls below a predefined threshold are discarded, as they likely contain only static scenes or negligible camera jitter. This step focuses our computational resources on dynamically rich content.
blocks.zh:
我们的数据处理管道从最初的过滤步骤开始,以确保我们只处理具有重大运动的视频。 为此,用固定的5秒间隔的取样片段处理上述数据集的原始视频。
我们用GMFlow来计算光学流度 用于带样视频片段 然后我们计算所有像素和框架的光学流矢量的平均值。 当这个平均值低于预定阈值时,剪贴被丢弃,因为它们可能只包含静态场景或可忽略不计的相机热点。 这一步骤使我们的计算资源集中于动态丰富的内容。

blocks.en: For each remaining clip, we extract a central 1.5-second segment and uniformly sample 7 frames. We compute bidirectional optical flow between adjacent frames with GMFlow. The optical flow fields from the central 7 frames yield 24 input channels (6 forward and 6 backward flows, each with 2 channels). These are fed into two modules: the Rigid Object Segmentation Module (ROSM) and the Motion Foreground Segmentation Module (MFSM).

blocks.en: 0.B.3 Module Outputs
blocks.zh: 0.B.3 模块产出

blocks.en: The outputs of the ROSM and MFSM are illustrated in Fig. A3 and Fig. A4 , respectively. Specifically, ROSM (Fig. A3 ) not only identifies rigid moving objects (e.g., spoons, cars) but also leverages parallax to segment static foreground objects (e.g., a table next to the dog) and discerns object parts (e.g., an elephant’s trunk, a human arm). In contrast, MFSM (Fig. A4 ) extracts a broader range of moving foreground elements, including pedestrians, animals, and human-object interactions.

blocks.en: 0.B.4 Data Postprocessing
blocks.zh: 0.B.4 国家 数据处理

blocks.en:
The raw masks generated by these two modules undergo a rigorous post-processing pipeline to ensure their quality and uniqueness.
First, to prune low-fidelity predictions, we introduce a Mask Quality Score ( S quality S_{\text{quality}} ) for each candidate mask.
This score synergizes two critical metrics. The first, maskness ( S maskness S_{\text{maskness}} ), quantifies model confidence by averaging the prediction values for all pixels exceeding a threshold of τ c = 0.5 \tau_{c}=0.5 .
The second, boundary sharpness ( S sharpness S_{\text{sharpness}} ), evaluates contour clarity by calculating the proportion of high-gradient pixels (magnitude > γ g = 0.3 >\gamma_{g}=0.3 ) within a 4-pixel-wide band around the mask’s binarized edge.
The final score is a weighted sum: S quality = β ⋅ S maskness + ( 1 − β ) ⋅ S sharpness S_{\text{quality}}=\beta\cdot S_{\text{maskness}}+(1-\beta)\cdot S_{\text{sharpness}} , where we set β = 0.4 \beta=0.4 to place a slightly higher emphasis on boundary sharpness.
Masks with a score below a stringent quality threshold of τ quality = 0.85 \tau_{\text{quality}}=0.85 are discarded.
Subsequently, to eliminate redundant masks for the same object, we employ Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS) [ 26 ] .
Finally, since frames with significant motion can suffer from blur, we filter the generated image-label pairs based on image sharpness. We assess this by calculating the variance of the Laplacian of the image region defined by the mask, and discard pairs where this variance falls below a threshold τ blur \tau_{\text{blur}} .
This multi-stage filtering protocol is crucial for populating our final dataset with sharp, distinct, and high-confidence pseudo-labels.

blocks.en: To provide a comprehensive understanding of MoSA, this section outlines the architectural design and implementation specifics of its key components. We will first describe the Multi-Granularity Motion Segmentation (MGMS) pipeline, which extracts candidate object masks from unlabeled videos by identifying coherently moving regions. Subsequently, we will detail the Perceptual Grouping Model (PGM) , focusing on its Vision Transformer architecture [ 8 ] and the training and inference procedures. Lastly, we will describe the Whole-Image Segmentation and Promptable Segmentation models. These models are designed to distill object concepts learned by the PGM, enabling high-resolution segmentation capabilities across entire images, akin to a “segment anything” functionality.
blocks.zh: 为了全面了解卫生部,本节概述了该部主要组成部分的建筑设计和实施细节。 我们首先要描述“多角运动分块”管道,该管道通过识别一致移动的区域,从无标签的视频中提取候选物体口罩。 随后,我们将详细介绍概念组合模型(PGM),侧重于其愿景变换器架构[8]以及培训和推论程序. 最后,我们将介绍全图象分片和快速分片模型。 这些模型旨在提炼PGM所学到的物体概念,使整个图像具有高分辨率的分解能力,类似于“任何部分”功能。

blocks.en: 0.C.1 MGMS Pipeline
blocks.zh: 0.C.1 导弹监测系统 管道

blocks.en: Our MGMS Pipeline is composed of two interconnected modules: Rigid Object Segmentation Module (ROSM) and Motion Foreground Segmentation Module (MFSM). We now detail the model architecture and training procedures for each of these modules. Table A1 shows their specific training hyperparameters.
blocks.zh: 我们的MGMS 管道由两个相互关联的模块组成: 刚性对象分区模块(ROSM)和运动前缘分区模块(MFSM). 我们现在详细说明每个单元的示范结构和培训程序。 表A1显示了他们的具体训练超参数。

blocks.en: Rigid Object Segmentation Module
blocks.zh: 刚性对象分割模块

blocks.en: This module is dedicated to segmenting individual rigidly moving objects. We adapt the SOLOv2 [ 35 ] architecture, modifying its input to utilize bidirectional optical flow. Given that the input is solely optical flow, which has a relatively low information density compared to RGB images, we employ a lightweight ResNet-18 [ 12 ] as the backbone to achieve strong performance efficiently. • Input : The input to this module is bidirectional optical flow. For an input video clip of length t = 7 t=7 frames, we extract t − 1 = 6 t-1=6 forward and t − 1 = 6 t-1=6 backward optical flow fields. Each optical flow field has 2 channels (x and y components). Thus, the total number of input channels is ( t − 1 ) × 2 × 2 = 24 (t-1)\times 2\times 2=24 . The input spatial resolution is 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixels. • Output : The module outputs instance segmentation masks for rigidly moving objects within the central frame of the input clip.

blocks.en: 0.C.2 Perceptual Grouping Model (PGM)
blocks.zh: 0.C.2 概念分组模式

blocks.en: The Perceptual Grouping Model (PGM) is trained to internalize perceptual grouping principles from motion-derived pseudo-masks, enabling it to segment unseen objects in static images. This section details its training hyperparameters and inference strategy.
blocks.zh: 概念分组模型(PGM)被训练为从运动衍生的伪面团中将概念分组原理内化,使其能在静态图像中分解看不见的物体. 本节详述其训练超参数和推断策略。

blocks.en: PGM Training Details
blocks.zh: 首相 培训详情

blocks.en: Motion cues were extracted from a 10,000-hour video dataset using our MGMS pipeline. These cues, in the form of pseudo-masks, were subsequently filtered based on a mask quality score. This process yielded approximately 10,000,000 high-quality video frames, with an average of 2.1 pseudo-masks per frame. These frames and their corresponding motion-derived masks served as the training data for the PGM. The model was trained using a perceptual grouping contrastive learning strategy to learn the grouping logic inherent in these dynamic exemplars.
blocks.zh: 利用我们的MGMS输油管 从一个10000小时的视频数据集中提取了运动提示。 这些提示以伪面团的形式,随后根据面具质量分数过滤. 这个过程产生了大约1,000,000个高质量的视频帧,平均每帧有2.1个伪质量. 这些帧及其相应的运动产生的口罩是PGM的训练数据. 该模型是利用一种感知的分组对比性学习策略来学习这些动态实例中固有的分组逻辑的.

blocks.en: As described in the main paper, our PGM employs K = 4 K=4 parallel heads to specialize in segmenting objects of varying scales. During training, each pseudo-mask is deterministically assigned to a specific head based on the size of its normalized bounding box. First, for each pseudo-mask, we compute its tightest bounding box and normalize its coordinates to the range of [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , resulting in coordinates ( x min , y min , x max , y max ) (x_{\text{min}},y_{\text{min}},x_{\text{max}},y_{\text{max}}) . We then calculate a scale metric, s s , defined as the geometric mean of the bounding box’s side lengths: s = ( x max − x min ) ⋅ ( y max − y min ) s=\sqrt{(x_{\text{max}}-x_{\text{min}})\cdot(y_{\text{max}}-y_{\text{min}})} (A1) A pseudo-mask is then assigned to one of the four heads based on the value of s s according to the following criteria: • Head 1 : Assigned masks with s < 1 8 s<\frac{1}{8} (small objects). • Head 2 : Assigned masks with 1 8 ≤ s < 1 4 \frac{1}{8}\leq s<\frac{1}{4} (medium-small objects). • Head 3 : Assigned masks with 1 4 ≤ s < 1 2 \frac{1}{4}\leq s<\frac{1}{2} (medium-large objects). • Head 4 : Assigned masks with 1 2 ≤ s ≤ 1 \frac{1}{2}\leq s\leq 1 (large objects). This scale-based routing ensures that the loss for any given mask is computed exclusively by the head designated for its scale, compelling each head to develop expertise in segmenting objects within its specific size range. The PGM was trained on a server with 8 NVIDIA A100 GPUs. Specific training hyperparameters are detailed in Table A2 .

blocks.en: PGM Inference Strategy
blocks.zh: 首相 推论战略

blocks.en: The PGM is trained primarily on video frames, which often present inherent challenges such as lower resolutions (typically 360p to 720p) and significant motion blur. These characteristics can limit the effective resolution perceived by the model. Furthermore, the PGM’s ViT-B/8 architecture, given a 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixel training input, generates segmentation maps at a coarse 64 × 64 64\times 64 resolution. To bridge this gap and enable high-resolution segmentation, especially for smaller objects and finer details, we implement a multi-scale tiling inference strategy. The procedure is as follows:
blocks.zh: PGM主要接受关于视频帧的培训,这往往带来内在的挑战,如分辨率较低(通常为360p到720p)和显著的运动模糊. 这些特征可以限制模型所感知的有效分辨率. 此外,PGM的ViT-B/8架构提供了512×512 512\times 512像素训练输入,以粗64×64 64\times 64分辨率生成分区图. 为了弥合这一差距并促成高分辨率的分解,特别是对于较小的物体和更细细的细节,我们实施了一个多尺度的叠加推论策略. 程序如下:

blocks.en: 1. Global Context Pass: The entire input image is initially resized to 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixels and processed by the PGM. This step yields a coarse, global segmentation map. 2. Multi-Scale Sliding Window Pass: The original, high-resolution image is subsequently processed using sliding tiles at two distinct scales: • Scale 1: Tiles of size s 1 × s 1 s_{1}\times s_{1} , where s 1 = 1 2 ​ min ⁡ ( width , height ) s_{1}=\frac{1}{2}\min(\text{width},\text{height}) . • Scale 2: Tiles of size s 2 × s 2 s_{2}\times s_{2} , where s 2 = 1 4 ​ min ⁡ ( width , height ) s_{2}=\frac{1}{4}\min(\text{width},\text{height}) . These tiles are applied with a 50% overlap to ensure comprehensive coverage and smooth transitions. The PGM performs an independent inference on each tile. 3. Aggregation and Refinement: The segmentation masks from the global pass and all tiles are aggregated. Non-Maximum Suppression [ 26 ] is then applied to the combined predictions to resolve overlaps and redundant detections. As a final refinement step, we apply a fully-connected Conditional Random Field (CRF) [ 18 ] to the resulting masks. CRF leverages the color information from the original high-resolution image to sharpen mask boundaries, yielding a pixel-accurate final segmentation.

blocks.en: 0.C.3 Adaptation to Segment Anything
blocks.zh: 0.C.3 适应任何部分

blocks.en: To operationalize the learned perceptual grouping principles, we distill the knowledge from the PGM into two Segment Anything models: a whole-image segmentation model for automatic segmentation and a promptable segmentation model for interactive use.
blocks.zh: 为了实施所学到的感知分组原则,我们把PGM的知识提炼成两个部分的任意模式:一个用于自动分割的全图像分割模型和一个可交互使用的快速分割模型。

blocks.en: Whole-Image Segmentation Model
blocks.zh: 全图像分割模型

blocks.en: This model is designed for automatic, high-resolution segmentation. It employs a DINO pre-trained ResNet-50 backbone with a Mask2former decoder. To effectively manage the high density of perceptual grouping masks generated by the PGM, the decoder is configured with 1000 learnable object queries, though we sample a maximum of 400 masks per image during loss computation to ensure training efficiency. The model was trained for 8 epochs using the AdamW optimizer with a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} and a batch size of 16, using random 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 crops for data augmentation.
blocks.zh: 此型号为自动,高分辨率分解设计. 它使用一个DINO预先训练的ResNet-50骨干,并配备了Mask2former解码器. 为了有效管理PGM生成的感知组装口罩的高密度,解码器配置了1000个可学习对象查询,不过我们在损失计算时对每个图像最多400个口罩进行取样以确保训练效率. 该模型使用亚当W优化器为8个纪元进行了培训,学习率为5×10−5 5\times 10×5}批量尺寸为16,随机使用1024×1024 1024\times 1024作物进行数据增强.

blocks.en: Promptable Segmentation model
blocks.zh: 可快速分割模型

blocks.en: This model is built for interactive use, generating hierarchical masks from user prompts. It is based on the Semantic-SAM framework and uses a self-supervised pretrained Swin-Tiny backbone. A key feature is its ability to output 6 masks for each prompt, capturing different levels of semantic granularity (e.g., a part, the whole object, and a group of objects). This design is inspired by the nested structure of real-world annotations. The model was trained for 4 epochs with a batch size of 8, using AdamW with a base learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} and a multi-step decay schedule.
blocks.zh: 这个模型是为交互使用而构建的,从用户提示中生成等级面具. 它以语义-SAM框架为基础,并使用自我监督的预先训练的Swin-Tiny骨干. 一个关键特征是它能为每个快件输出6个口罩,捕捉不同水平的语义颗粒(如一个部分,整个物体,以及一组物体). 这种设计灵感来源于现实世界说明的嵌套结构. 该型号为4个纪元训练,批量大小为8,使用亚当W,基础学习率为1×10−4 1\times 10×4}以及多步衰变时间表.

blocks.en: 0.D.1 Mask Quality Filtering

blocks.en: The mask quality score in our MGMS post-processing stage combines maskness and boundary sharpness. Table A3 shows that the two criteria are complementary. Using maskness alone yields 24.1 average AR, while using boundary sharpness alone yields 22.8 average AR. Combining both scores improves the average AR to 28.8, confirming that reliable mask confidence and crisp boundaries are both important for constructing high-quality motion pseudo-labels.

blocks.en: We also compare MGMS with representative video-based unsupervised segmentation methods. OCLR [ 40 ] and VideoCutLER [ 37 ] mainly target instance-level video segmentation, whereas MGMS is designed to extract multi-granularity motion masks for learning a transferable object prior. As shown in Table A4 , MGMS achieves competitive zero-shot video segmentation performance on DAVIS2017, reaching 55.9 𝒥 & ℱ \mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F} . This is close to VideoCutLER (57.3) and OCLR (55.1), even though MGMS and OCLR use only optical flow while VideoCutLER uses RGB appearance cues.
blocks.zh: 我们还将MGMS与具有代表性的基于视频的无监督分解方法进行比较. OCLR [40] 和 VideoCutLER [37] 主要是瞄准实例级的视频分割,而MGMS则是为了在学习一个可转移对象之前提取多角运动口罩. 如表A4所示,MGMS在DAVIS2017上实现了竞争性的零镜头视频分区性能,达到了55.9 J & F\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}. 这接近VideoCutLER(57.3)和OCLR(55.1),尽管MGMS和OCLR只使用光学流,而VideoCutLER则使用RGB外观提示.

blocks.en: Appendix 0.F Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录0.F 限制

blocks.en: Our current work focuses on extracting general segmentation knowledge from motion cues, with the goal of enabling zero-shot segmentation on static images without relying on explicit motion information during inference. Consequently, all evaluation experiments have been conducted on image datasets. Future research will extend MoSA to video data, exploring its applicability and adaptation to dynamic scenes and temporal segmentation tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们目前的工作重点是从运动提示中提取一般的分块知识,目标是在推论过程中不依赖明显的运动信息而使静态图像零射分块成为可能。 因此,对图像数据集进行了所有评价试验。 未来的研究将把MOSA扩展至视频数据,探索其对动态场景和时间分割任务的可适用性和适应性.

blocks.en: One practical failure mode arises from degraded motion estimation in low-light environments, such as night scenes. Since our pseudo-label generation stage depends on optical flow, unreliable flow can fail to provide clear motion cues and may weaken the learned supervision for fine structures. For example, as shown in the penultimate row of Fig. A5 , MoSA can struggle to segment subtle body parts such as legs in dark regions, whereas a fully supervised model such as SAM can still succeed with dense manual supervision. Improving robustness to low-light videos and other flow-degraded conditions is an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 一个实际的失败模式产生于低光度环境中的退化运动估计,如夜幕. 由于我们的伪标签生成阶段依赖于光学流,不可靠的流可能无法提供清晰的运动提示,并可能削弱精细结构的学习监督. 例如,如Fig的倒数第二行所示. A5,MOSA在黑暗区域可以挣扎分解腿部等微妙的肢体部位,而像SAM这样的完全监督的模型在密集的人工监管下仍然可以成功. 提高稳健度至低光影视等流降级条件,是今后工作的重要方向.

blocks.en: Figure A3 : Rigid Object Segmentation Module (ROSM) output examples. For each case, the first three columns show key input frames, and the fourth column presents ROSM’s segmentation of the dominant rigidly moving entity. ROSM effectively segments whole rigid objects (cars, spoon), isolates articulated parts (elephant’s ear/trunk, human head), and distinguishes smaller moving components (leaves). Furthermore, ROSM can leverage parallax cues from camera motion to segment static objects(e.g., table next to the dog).
blocks.zh: 图A3 : 刚性对象分割模块(ROSM)输出示例. 对于每个案例,前三列显示关键输入框,第四列显示ROSM对主力刚性移动实体的分割. ROSM有效地将整块刚性物体(汽车,勺子)分割开来,将拼接的部分(elephant的耳朵/trunk,人头)隔离开来,并区分较小的移动部件(leaves). 此外,ROSM还可以利用从相机运动到分割静态物体(如狗旁边的桌子)的抛物线提示.

blocks.en: Figure A4 : Motion Foreground Segmentation Module (MFSM) effectively extracts all moving foreground elements. For each case, the first three columns display representative input frames, while the fourth column shows MFSM’s segmentation results.
blocks.zh: 图A4:运动前景分区模块(MFSM)有效提取所有移动前景元素. 每例前三列显示代表性输入帧,而第四列显示MFSM的分解结果.

blocks.en: Figure A5 : Additional qualitative results for whole-image segmentation, comparing our MoSA (rightmost column) with the supervised SAM [ 15 ] (second column) and the previous state-of-the-art unsupervised method UnSAM [ 38 ] (third column). Note that UnSAM is not strictly unsupervised, as its refinement stage utilizes the supervised CascadePSP [ 7 ] refiner.
blocks.zh: 图A5:全图像分解的附加定性结果,比较我们的MOSA(最右栏)与被监督的SAM[15](第二栏)和之前最先进的无监督方法UNSAM[38](第三栏). 注意UNSAM并非严格无监督,因为其完善阶段使用受监督的CascadePSP[7]精炼器.

blocks.en: Figure A6 : Comparative results for promptable image segmentation, evaluating our unsupervised MoSA against supervised SAM [ 15 ] and unsupervised UnSAM [ 38 ] across diverse scenario. The examples illustrate that when prompted by points (indicated as star marks), MoSA consistently generates multi-granular segmentation masks of higher visual quality. Note that UnSAM is not strictly unsupervised, as its refinement stage utilizes the supervised CascadePSP [ 7 ] refiner.
blocks.zh: 图A6:快速图像分解的比较结果,对照受监督的SAM[15]和无监督的UNSAM[38],评估我们无监督的MOSA在各种情景下的比较结果。 例子说明,当点(表示为恒星标记)的刺激下,MOSA持续生成视觉质量较高的多角分化口罩. 注意UNSAM并非严格无监督,因为其完善阶段使用受监督的CascadePSP[7]精炼器.
